summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist persistence audit  **What I already checked (read-only, no changes made):** I traced the full path — `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` schema → `db/auth.ts` session lookup → `server.ts` router mounting. On static reading, the wiring looks *correct*: every watchlist route requires a valid session, every query is scoped by the real `user_id` (no default/anonymous fallback), the client sends `credentials: "include"` on every call, and there's no localStorage/sessionStorage usage anywhere
